topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of conduct; POL-05 acknowledged at hire and yearly; discipline under POL-01 4.11 and the collective bargaining agreements
evidence: Code of conduct; acknowledgment report (95%); discipline log

control_description: Board audit committee receives quarterly cyber risk reports from the vCISO, including the TSA CAP annual report summary
gap: Shared service risks and commitments are not reported to the committee separately; one meeting on record under the new format
remediation: Add a shared service section to each quarterly report through the observation period

control_description: COO is system owner; Cybersecurity Manager runs the program; Director of Customer Service and Car Management owns the shared car management service; reporting lines in POL-01
Hiring standards and FRA certification for dispatch roles; annual security awareness; TSA security training
evidence: Training completion report (96%); TSA training records
gap: Dispatcher, PTC administrator, and maintainer role training has no cybersecurity content (P07 AT-3)
remediation: Role-based cyber training (POAM-012)

control_description: Control owners named for every control in the SSP; security objectives in director performance goals
TDPO component inventory; SIEM for IT; CAD/CTC train sheets and dispatcher log as the system of record
gap: OT inventory about 70% complete; CAD/CTC logs not collected centrally, so control operation cannot be fully evidenced (P07 CM-8, AU-2)
remediation: Complete the inventory; forward CAD/CTC logs (POAM-006, POAM-008)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies published on the intranet; annual awareness; shift briefings in the NOC for dispatch procedures
Service agreements with the 2 affiliates and the contracted short line state service levels (2-hour dispatch restoration)
control_owner: Director of Customer Service and Car Management
gap: No system description or written security commitments for client railroads; agreements lack security requirements and incident notice detail (P07 CA-3)
remediation: Management's system description; security schedule added to each service agreement (POAM-014)

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Service objectives defined: dispatch availability, car record accuracy, restoration within 2 hours
Annual SP 800-30 risk assessment covers the shared service (P01 R-047 and the TDPO risks)
Fraud risks considered for payments (business email compromise, P01 R-022)
gap: No fraud risk assessment for the shared service (for example manipulated car records or billing for affiliates)
remediation: Add shared service fraud scenarios to the 2027 risk assessment

control_description: Change in operations assessed when the shared service started (2025-07)
gap: The change was not filed with TSA as a CIP amendment (P03 G-051), and the contracted short line's 2027 start has not been assessed
remediation: CIP amendment (POAM-018); assess the 2027 onboarding before go-live

control_description: Annual independent assessment by the co-sourced internal audit firm; TSA CAP schedule
gap: CAP one-third minimum missed last plan year; architecture design review overdue (P07 CA-2)
remediation: Quarterly CAP schedule; design review 2026-11 (POAM-017)

control_description: Findings tracked in the POA&M; quarterly reporting to the COO and audit committee

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the SP 800-53 Moderate baseline with tailoring for the TDPO
IT general controls for identity, change, and operations; standards being issued
gap: Configuration, logging, and contingency standards are in draft (P06)
remediation: Issue STD-01, STD-02, STD-07

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: POL-01 to POL-05 approved 2026-09-15, effective 2026-10-01
gap: Standards and procedures behind the policies are not all issued
remediation: Standards issue schedule (P06 section 4)

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: MFA for remote, privileged, cloud, and TMS access; PAM for administrators; console logins per dispatcher with CIP compensating controls
evidence: IdP and PAM configuration; P07 IA-2(1) (25 of 25)
gap: 2 shared dispatcher logins at the backup NOC, which serves the affiliate desks (P07 IA-2)
remediation: Named accounts (POAM-002)

control_description: Accounts created on approved requests from the manager and system owner, including affiliate desk accounts
evidence: P07 AC-2: 25 of 25 new accounts approved

control_description: Role-based access in CAD/CTC and the TMS, segregated by railroad
gap: Application roles reviewed annually, not quarterly; 2 maintainers with CAD/CTC administrator rights; late removal of tablet and TMS accounts (P07 AC-2, AC-5, AC-6)
remediation: Quarterly application role reviews; remove dual rights; termination workflow (POAM-001, POAM-002)

control_description: Badge access to both NOCs, the HQ data center, and the backup server room; visitor escort
control_owner: Director of Safety, Security, and Hazmat
evidence: Badge reports; P07 PE-3 (NOC and data center statements satisfied)

control_description: Media and retired equipment wiped or destroyed with a record

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Deny-by-default boundary firewalls at the data center and NOCs; PAM jump host for vendors
gap: The radio vendor's always-on VPN reaches the backhaul that carries dispatch radio for the affiliate desks (P07 AC-17, SC-7)
remediation: Move the vendor to the jump host (POAM-004)

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS for the TMS, EDI, and client portals; encrypted file transfer with client railroads

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on all Windows endpoints and servers including consoles; application allowlisting on consoles
evidence: P07 SI-3 (5 of 5 test files blocked)

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Monthly IT scans; weekly KEV review for IT
gap: CAD/CTC servers 14 months behind certified patches; OT outside the KEV review (P07 RA-5, SI-2)
remediation: Patch to the certified level; OT in KEV review (POAM-007)

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: MSSP 24x7 monitoring of IT logs
gap: CAD/CTC application events, the core of the shared dispatch service, are not monitored (P07 AU-2, AU-6, SI-4)
remediation: Forward CAD/CTC logs; MSSP use cases (POAM-006)

control_description: Events triaged by the MSSP and the incident commander
gap: Events not classified against the directive's definition; identification time not recorded (P07 IR-6)
remediation: Classification checklist (POAM-013)

control_description: Cybersecurity Incident Response Plan; P08 runbooks
gap: Plan lacks OT and TMS scenarios until the runbooks are adopted; client notice not yet exercised (P07 IR-4, IR-8)
remediation: Adopt runbooks; 2026-12-10 exercise including affiliate notice (POAM-012)

control_description: Hot standby at the backup NOC; write-once backups
gap: Restore of CAD/CTC from backups never tested; 2-hour restoration commitment not demonstrated (P07 CP-4, CP-10)
remediation: Clean-room restore 2026-11-05, then quarterly (POAM-011)

control_description: Change advisory board for CAD/CTC, BOS, and TMS configuration changes
gap: Field controller changes lack security impact analysis; vendor updates not always tested before production (P07 CM-3)
remediation: Field change procedure; STD-01 (POAM-009)

control_description: Business continuity through the backup NOC and manual dispatch
gap: No cyber compromise scenario; no plan for a storm affecting both NOCs (P07 CP-2)
remediation: Revised contingency plan and STD-07 (POAM-010)

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Vendor reviews for the TMS, cloud, and identity provider; Part B program
gap: Tier 1 OT vendor reviews still open; no security terms in OT vendor contracts (P07 SA-9)
remediation: Complete Tier 1 reviews; contract terms (POAM-014)

control_description: Capacity for the affiliate desks planned when the service started (4 consoles added); CAD/CTC capacity reviewed yearly
Backup NOC with hot standby; generator and UPS at both NOCs; write-once backups in a second region
evidence: Generator test log; backup reports (P07 CP-9 satisfied)
gap: A single hurricane could affect both NOCs (P01 R-028); no alternate dispatch arrangement
remediation: Emergency read access in the cloud clean room; affiliate emergency dispatch support (POAM-010)

control_description: Annual failover tests
gap: Recovery plan not tested for restore from backup or for a cyber scenario (P07 CP-4)
remediation: Quarterly restore tests; first 2026-11-05 (POAM-011)
